metaDescription: Public API reference for server-side lead intake, file uploads, lead synchronization, and analytics.
overviewDescription: Connect a custom website to OPS for server-side lead intake, direct photo and file upload, privacy-safe lead synchronization, and versioned analytics.
overviewBoundaryBody: Send the original form submission. OPS captures later messages and attachments from the email thread.
authenticationBody: Authenticate every API request with a bearer credential created in OPS. Intake and analytics access can be separated by credential and scope.
authenticationWarning: Keep every OPS credential on your server. Never place it in browser code, a mobile app, or a public repository.
authenticationIntakeScope: Creates intake records and reads intake configuration or submission status.
authenticationAnalyticsScope: Reads privacy-safe lead projections and versioned metrics.
quickStartDescription: Use this sequence for an original form submission that may include photos or files.
quickStartConfigBody: Load the source, form, and current upload limits available to the intake credential.
quickStartReserveBody: Your server requests single-use upload capabilities for the files selected by the customer.
quickStartUploadBody: The browser receives only the single-use upload capability returned by your server.
quickStartSubmitBody: Your server submits the original form data and the reserved upload IDs with one idempotency key.
quickStartPollBody: Poll only while attachment processing is non-terminal and honor the returned delay.
leadIntakeDescription: Create the original customer and lead record, attach reserved files, and read safe processing status.
leadAnalyticsDescription: Synchronize every privacy-safe lead projection with source characteristics or request versioned aggregate metrics.
leadSyncBody: Complete a full paged sync first. Store the terminal checkpoint, then use it for incremental changes. Lead projections omit customer contact details.
financialScopeBody: Metrics that disclose financial values require the additional analytics.financial.read scope. Non-financial lead metrics use analytics.leads.read.
copyFailedStatus: Copy failed. Select the code and copy it manually.
errorsBody: Errors use one safe envelope with a stable code, message, request ID, and optional field details. Log the request ID when contacting OPS.
errorsRetryBody: Retry 429 and 503 responses only. Honor Retry-After and use bounded exponential backoff. Reuse the same idempotency key when retrying a write after an unknown outcome.
errorsConflictBody: A 409 response means the same idempotency key was reused with different input. Do not retry until the request is corrected.
limitsBody: Read intake configuration before accepting files. It returns the current content types, file count, per-file size, batch size, JSON body, and answer limits for the credential.
limitsCredentialBody: Use separate intake and analytics credentials, restrict each one to the required scope, rotate on exposure, and revoke credentials that are no longer used.
limitsDataBody: Analytics returns source characteristics and operational outcomes without customer contact details, raw attachments, internal IDs, or storage information.
resourcesBody: Use the OpenAPI 3.1 document as the machine-readable contract for validation, client generation, and independent review.
openApiResourceBody: Canonical paths, schemas, examples, scopes, and response envelopes for the published API.
